import copy


class View:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows = []
        self.notes = {}
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None
        self.seq = 0
        self._last_id_finished = False

    def begin(self, query):
        self.seq += 1
        self.error = None
        self.loading = True
        self._last_id_finished = False
        return self.seq

    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        if request_id != self.seq or self._last_id_finished:
            return False
        self._last_id_finished = True
        self.rows = copy.deepcopy(rows)
        self.loading = False
        return True

from view import View


def test_basic_flow():
    v = View()
    assert v.loading is False
    rid1 = v.begin('q1')
    assert rid1 == 1
    assert v.loading is True
    assert v.error is None
    assert v.finish(rid1, [('a', 1)]) is True
    assert v.rows == [('a', 1)]
    assert v.loading is False


def test_stale_and_duplicate_replies():
    v = View()
    rid1 = v.begin('q1')
    rid2 = v.begin('q2')
    assert v.finish(rid1, [('old', 1)]) is False
    assert v.rows == []
    assert v.finish(rid2, [('new', 2)]) is True
    assert v.rows == [('new', 2)]
    assert v.finish(rid2, [('dup', 3)]) is False
    assert v.rows == [('new', 2)]


def test_finish_before_any_begin_returns_false():
    v = View()
    assert v.finish(999, [('x', 0)]) is False
    assert v.rows == []


def test_error_cleared_on_begin():
    v = View()
    v.error = 'boom'
    v.begin('q')
    assert v.error is None
    assert v.loading is True


def test_rows_preserved_until_valid_finish():
    v = View()
    rid1 = v.begin('q1')
    v.finish(rid1, [('pre', 1)])
    rid2 = v.begin('q2')
    assert v.finish(rid1, [('stale', 2)]) is False
    assert v.rows == [('pre', 1)]
    assert v.finish(rid2, [('post', 3)]) is True
    assert v.rows == [('post', 3)]


def test_rows_are_copied():
    src = [('a', 1)]
    v = View()
    rid = v.begin('q')
    v.finish(rid, src)
    src[0] = ('mutated', 99)
    assert v.rows == [('a', 1)]


def test_notes_preserved():
    v = View()
    v.notes[1] = 'job note'
    v.begin('q')
    v.notes[1] = 'job note still here'
    v.finish(1, [('r', 1)])
    assert v.notes[1] == 'job note still here'
    v2 = View()
    v2.notes[1] = 'other'
    v2.begin('q')
    assert v2.notes[1] == 'other'
    v2.finish(1, [('r', 1)])


def test_multiple_ends():
    v = View()
    ids = [v.begin(f'q{i}') for i in range(1, 6)]
    assert ids == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    assert v.finish(3, 'x') is True
    assert v.rows == 'x'


def test_no_begings_yields_no_finish():
    v = View()
    assert v.finish(1, [1, 2]) is False
    assert v.rows == []
    assert v.loading is False


if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_basic_flow()
    test_stale_and_duplicate_replies()
    test_finish_before_any_begin_returns_false()
    test_error_cleared_on_begin()
    test_rows_preserved_until_valid_finish()
    test_rows_are_copied()
    test_notes_preserved()
    test_multiple_ends()
    test_no_begings_yields_no_finish()
    print('ALL TESTS PASSED')
